name: Eldred Brown Penrose
original_name: エルドレッド・ブラウン・ペンローズ
source:
Our esteemed [url=/c156154]Lady Scarlet[/url]'s old man.
He's a Duke, and the leader of the Imperial Army.
His fierce loyalty to the Emperor and long list of military merits means that he's kinda worshiped.

[From Digital Artwork book]
